contexts.text: That they were naked, and did not blush () = that they were innocent; that is to say, that the Lord had insinuated innocence into their proprium...

That the nakedness at which they did not blush = innocence, is manifestly evident from (the fact) that when integrity and innocence had receded, they blushed at their nakedness... and also from the things which are represented in the World of Spirits; for when Spirits want to exculpate themselves, and prove that they are blameless, they present themselves naked... AC 821:2. SE 1206.
Especially [is it evident] from the innocent in Heaven, who appear as naked infants... AC 2306.

They Knew that they were naked () = that they Knew and acknowledged that they were not, as before, in innocence, but in evil. Explained... For, when men are in no innocence, nakedness is a shame and a reproach; because they are conscious that they think evilly. Hence nakedness is taken in the Word for reproach and evil, and is predicated of a perverted Church. Illustrated.
They are called naked, because left to proprium; for (such) no longer have anything of intelligence and wisdom, or of faith. Being thus made naked of truth and good, they are therefore in evil.

The Most Ancients, on account of their innocence, were called naked; and afterwards, when innocence perished, they observed that they were in evil, which also is called nakedness... Here, therefore, they are said to be clothed, lest they should be naked, or in evil.

(Noah) was uncovered in the midst of his tent () = things perverted, as is evident from the signification of uncovered, or naked. For he is called uncovered and naked, from the drunkenness of wine, in whom there are no truths of faith; and still more he with whom they are perverted. Explained.
He saw the nakedness of his father () = that he observed the errors and perverted things; (for) nakedness = what is evil and perverted. Explained.
They covered the nakedness of their father () = that they excused the perverted things.
Not in naked Truths.
Genuine innocence represented by a naked infant.
The naked (a class of the good).
By the naked () they perceive those who acknowledge that there is nothing of good and truth in themselves. AC 5433:4.

To see the nakedness of the land are ye come () = that nothing seemed better to them than for themselves to know that they are not truths... Nakedness = to be devoid of truth; thus, that they are not truths... Explained. Here, therefore, the nakedness of the land = no truths in the Church.
The reason nakedness = what is deprived of truths, or devoid of truths, is that garments in general = truths.
That nakedness = being devoid of truths. Illustrated.
Naked () = to be in penury of truth.
The shame of nakedness () = to be devoid of goods and truths.
Lest he walk naked () = lest he be devoid of truths.
To cover the naked with a garment () = to instruct in truths those who long for truths.
To strip her naked () = that she may be devoid of truths. AC 6432:5. AC 10402:6.
I will show thy nakedness to the nations () = ugliness: all ugliness is from the absence of truths. ( = the infernal loves which defile the interiors. AC 9960:11.)
For man does not apprehend naked spiritual things.
In general, they called those... the naked, whom they were to clothe.
Those who live in the hot zones (of Jupiter) go naked, but with a covering round the loins; nor do they blush at nakedness; for their minds are chaste.

(The Spirits of our Earth) were told that nakedness is not a matter of shame nor reproach to those who live in chastity and a state of innocence; but that it is so to those who live in lasciviousness and immodesty. AC 8545:end.
If spiritual and celestial things were set forth nakedly, they would be rejected...

That thy nakedness be not revealed upon it () = the idea of thought concerning these things thus full of falsities... Nakedness = what is destitute of truths; thus the idea of thought full of falsities.
For the celestial things which are of the good of love in Heaven are represented naked; and therefore those who are of the Celestial Kingdom appear naked... AC 9212:3. AC 9262. AC 9515. AC 9814.

To cover the flesh of nakedness () = lest the interiors of the love, which are filthy and infernal, should appear... The genitals and loins, which are here signified by the flesh of nakedness = the interior things of conjugial love... and, in the opposite sense, they = the evil, filthy, and infernal things of this love.

As to nakedness, it derives a signification from the parts of the body which appear naked... therefore it has one signification when the nakedness regards the head, which is baldness; another when it regards the whole body; and another when it regards the loins and genitals. When the nakedness regards the head... it = deprivation of intelligence of truth and wisdom of good; when it regards the whole body, it = deprivation of the truths of faith; but when it regards the loins and genitals, it = deprivation of the good of love. (These three significations of nakedness illustrated in order.)
I was naked, and ye clothed Me... Naked, here, = those who are not in truths, and still long for truths; and also those who acknowledge that there is nothing of good and truth in them.
To reveal the nakedness () = to cause that the filthy and infernal things, which are the ends, should appear.
To see the nakedness () = to see the filthy and infernal loves.
To be made naked () = to be made completely destitute of truths.

To reveal nakednesses = to reveal the evils of the loves of self and of the world, which are infernal; to reveal their father's nakednesses () = to reveal those evils which are hereditary and from the Voluntary.

The garment with which Shem and Japheth covered Noah's nakedness = the truth of faith by means of which these evils were covered and amended... The nakedness itself = his evil Voluntary, which is covered by means of the truths of faith; and, when it is being covered, the truths look backwards.
Under Jew, see this reference.
But, when the interiors are chaste, then nakedness = innocence, because it = conjugial love.
From these things it may again be evident why by nakednesses are signified (these) filthy and infernal things...
For the nakednesses (of Aaron and his sons) signified all loves contrary to heavenly loves...
Therefore it is said that Jehovah walks in the midst of the camp... lest He see the nakedness of anything... (). Nakedness = what is unclean from evils and falsities.
By this word dissolute in the Original Language is also signified... to be made naked; and by made naked is signified deprived of the good of love and truths of faith.
(Naked men seen in the Fifth Earth.) AC 10755. Described.
They have a perception as to whether the Conjugial is with those of their own nation who are naked... Explained.
The preacher then came to those who were naked, but had an inflamed body; and lastly to those who were black, some of whom were naked...
(In the Sixth Earth) they walk quite naked, and nakedness is no shame to them. AC 10837.
For the Angels of the Inmost Heaven are naked.
These Angels are naked, because nakedness corresponds to innocence.

What genuine innocence is, was represented by a most beautiful infant... naked; for the innocent themselves, who are in the Inmost Heaven... appear as infants, and some of them naked; for innocence is represented by nakedness at which they do not blush; as is read of the first man and his wife... and therefore, when their state of innocence had perished, they blushed at their nakedness...

The truths of the sense of the letter of the Word, as to a part of them, are not naked truths, but are appearances of truth... Naked truths themselves, which are included, contained, invested, and comprehended, are in the spiritual sense of the Word; and naked goods are in its celestial sense. Illustrated.
In the sense of the letter, in some places, there are not naked truths, but clothed ones...
I saw them stripped of their garments; a sign that they were devoid of truths.

The Word in the literal sense is like a man clothed, whose face is naked, and also his hands. All the things which pertain to the life, and thus to the salvation, of man, are naked there; but all the rest are clothed...
I will present (faith alone) in its nakedness...
For, prior or simpler things are more naked...
The nakedness (of Adam and Eve) at which they did not blush, signified that state (of innocence).

And blind and naked () = that they are devoid of the understanding of truth and the will of good... By the naked, in the Word, are meant those who are thence devoid of goods; for all spiritual good is procured by means of truths. AE 239.

That the shame of thy nakedness do not appear () = lest the good of celestial love be profaned and adulterated. No one can know what the shame of nakedness signifies, except him who knows that the members of generation in both sexes... correspond to celestial love... As man is born into loves opposite to this love, it is evident that if he does not procure for himself from the Lord the good of love and the truth of wisdom... he must appear in the opposite love, which, in itself, is profane. This is signified by to uncover the nakedness, and to manifest the shame of it. Illustrated.

By nakedness, in these passages, is signified the evils into which man is born; which, being opposite to the good of celestial love, in themselves are profane; and which are not removed except by means of truths and a life according to them.
By nakedness is also signified innocence; and likewise ignorance of good and truth. Illustrated.

That he walk not naked, and they see his shame () = lest they be with those who are in no truths, and their infernal loves appear. To walk naked = to live without truths. By the shame of nakedness, or the pudenda, are signified filthy loves, which are infernal loves... That by nakedness is signified ignorance of truth; and by the shame of nakedness, infernal love. Reference. These things are said to those who will be of the Lord's New Church, in order that they may learn truths, and remain in them; because without truths the evils connate with them, which are infernal loves, are not removed. A man can indeed live like a Christian without truths; but only before men, and not before the Angels. The truths which they are to learn are concerning the Lord, and concerning the precepts according to which they are to live. AE 1009.
And shall make her desolate and naked () = that they will put off from themselves her falsities and evils. Explained.
Nakedness, in the Word, is predicated of goods and evils.
There appeared two naked infants afar... But, when they approached more nearly still, they did not appear as infants, nor naked...
The state of innocence (of their conjugial love) was represented by their being seen as naked infants.
For innocence corresponds to infancy, and also to nakedness...
Lest the nakedness (of these dogmas) should appear.
He may opine that this heat is bare heat, and that this light is bare light, such as are the heat and light which proceed from the sun of our world...

The inhabitants (of Jupiter) under the equator, like the inhabitants of this Earth... go naked... The shame of nakedness comes forth from sin; and, in fact, from the blotting out of celestial love. Loves then succeed which cause nakedness to be a matter of shame... (Continued. See Jupiter (the planet).) SE 573.
(These women) appear naked about the middle part of the body, which signifies that they had loved (such natural things), and had supposed them to be beautiful.

Spirits can at once judge... from the body, its nakedness, where it is open, and especially which parts are exposed, and which they want to conceal, of what quality they had been in the life. Hence also Souls can Know themselves...
Those who have lived continually in quarrels... after death become like furies. They appear naked, both male and female... some only to the navel... SE 1348.
For, in the state of integrity, nakednesses were innocences... But, in the perverted state, nakednesses cannot even be named... because the loves are filthy.
The naked man (I saw in the vision) is the interior sense (of the Word); his garments are only the words, or the letter.
Concerning the nakedness of the head. Explained.
Concerning certain naked ones. Explained.
He had acquired many confirming things from the Word by means of... dishonourable nakednesses.
They lay backwards naked over my head.
If at this day Spirits and men were devoid of clothing, and were to appear naked, they would appear very deformed and ugly; and therefore it is better that they should be clothed.
(Very lascivious girls who exhibited themselves naked in order to testify their innocence.)

Conjugial love with the spiritual begins from externals... they love nudity, and it excites... Otherwise the celestial... they care not for nudities, as in the hot zones, where they see each other naked, but still love none except their own consorts. In the other life, also, the celestial appear naked, and the spiritual clothed; the latter are lascivious from their nature in the world; but not the former...
(In the Hell of the Genii) they are naked, because they have no spiritual light...
In some (of the imaginary Heavens) they present themselves naked, and thus appear above, as innocent...
Some (infernals) had the custom of sending forth Spirits... and presenting them naked from head to heel; by which they signified that they were innocent...

I arrived at a certain mountain, where all were naked, wives and husbands... They said they were all naked, both male and female; nor was anyone... excited with any lasciviousness... and also that when they come to their fanes all are naked, both male and female... and also that they cannot tolerate those who are clothed, because they are of a different genius. The reason they are such, is that they are in a sincere Conjugial... They explore (those whom they admit) by putting off their garments and presenting them naked, both male and females. They then at once perceive whether the Conjugial is in them... DeConj 68.

A certain person who had faith in the sense of the letter of the Word... was able, without emotion, to see (those) naked females; (but) on coming, naked, to those who were higher up, he was deprived of his senses... Such are they who believe the Word as to the sense of its letter, and do not know and have not imbued interior truths thence. Compare DeConj 69.

A Society of Catholics... appeared naked. All complained of this; but it was replied to them that this happens because above and at the sides neighbours arrive who are in truths; and then, from the influx from them, they appear naked, for the reason that they are void of truths...
(Christian Spirits) cannot endure the sphere of nakedness between consorts; but flee away from it.
In conjugial love... there is nothing of lascivious love, although they appear naked to each other.
There, all are naked, because there is no lasciviousness there which hurts modesty... (This Spirit) could not stay there.
There then appeared a naked man, whose back I saw. It was a certain Heaven which appeared thus...
To walk naked = life without the Knowledges of truth and good, as means; thus life not spiritual, but merely natural.
The nakednesses which they look on () = the deprivation of truth, and of the derivative intelligence. References.

That naked = those who are devoid of the understanding of truth because they are devoid of the will of good, is evident from the passages in the Word, adduced below, where naked, and nakedness are mentioned. The reason naked, and nakedness, = these things, is that garments = the truths which are of the understanding; and he who is devoid of truths is also devoid of good. Explained. Naked, and nakedness = ... deprivation of intelligence and of love for the additional reason that garments cover the body and flesh, (which) = good...
The reason the celestial Angels appear naked, is that they have no need of the memory to retain truths, nor of the derivative understanding to comprehend them...

From these things it may be evident what naked signifies, in both senses; namely, that in one sense it = those who are in celestial good; and, in the other, those who are not in good because not in truths. Illustrated.
Naked and barefoot () = that they are deprived of all truth and of all good.
The nakedness of Egypt () = the derivative falsities.
To cover nakedness () = to remove the evils of the will, and the falsities of the understanding.
Thy nakedness was revealed through thy scortations () = that the Church through falsities and falsifications has been deprived of all the understanding of truth.
The anus which shall be made naked () = the love of evil and falsity.
To look on nakednesses () = so that the falsities which are of the understanding, and the evils which are of the will appear.

As nakedness signified the deprivation of the understanding of truth and of the will of good, it was ordered that Aaron and his sons should not ascend by steps upon the altar, lest their nakedness be revealed upon it (). Also, that they should make them breeches of linen to cover the flesh of their nakedness... ().
Moreover, by naked, in the Word, are meant also those who are not in truths because they are ignorant of them, and yet long for them. Illustrated.
That naked also = the good of innocence. References.

That the shame of thy nakedness do not appear = lest filthy loves [do so]. Nakedness = deprivation of the understanding of truth and good, because of the will of them; or, the deprivation of the truth of faith because there is no good of love; and, as this deprivation is signified by nakedness, therefore by the shame of nakedness are signified filthy loves; for these appear when they are not removed through the love of good and the derivative faith of truth. Explained.
I have covered thy nakedness () = the hiding of evil through (spiritual truth).
To cover the naked () = to instruct in truths him who longs to be instructed. AE 386:26.
Naked () = him who is devoid of all understanding of truth. AE 357:22.
These have revealed her nakedness () = the deprivation of all truth and good... Nakedness = deprivation.
The falling down of the wall (of Jericho) = a making naked for everything evil and false.
Devastation as to truth and good is signified by to go spoiled and naked ().
The deprivation of all truth as before reformation took place, is signified by to strip her naked, and to present her according to the day of her birth ().

That they then saw themselves to be devoid of truths and goods, is signified by that the eyes of both were then opened, and they Knew that they were naked (). The nakedness which is ashamed = the deprivation of celestial love, and of the derivative good and truth.

The Word in ultimates is like a man clothed with a garment, who nevertheless is naked as to the face and hands; and, where the Word is thus naked, there appear its goods and truths naked as in Heaven; thus such as they are in the spiritual sense...

The reason why (the Angels of the Third Heaven) go naked, is that nakedness, in the spiritual sense, is innocence; and because garments = truths investing good; and truths investing good are in the memory, and thence in the thought; whereas with them truths are in the life; thus hidden; and they do not manifest themselves except before the perception while others are speaking them...
That he walk not naked () = lest he be without truths, and consequently without goods. (Explained.)

They shall make her devastated and naked () = the rejection of her falsities, which are falsified truths; and the manifestation then that they were devoid of all truth... By devastated and naked is signified to be devoid of all truth. Explained.

But still many things in the sense of the letter of the Word are naked, as it were devoid of garments; and these correspond to the face of a man, and also to his hands, which parts are naked. These things of the Word subserve for the doctrine of the Church, because in themselves they are spiritual natural truths; whence it may be evident... that man is able to find and see naked Truths even there.
That love truly conjugial is naked. (See Marriage Love.)
In the rest of the Heavens... all appear clothed, and they also blush at nakedness before the eyes of others, because it excites what is lascivious.
